about.defaultTitle:
A sea-based guesthouse,
sheltered in a mangrove bay.
about.defaultText1: Floating Paradise is proudly solar-powered. Built consciously above the water, it invites a slower rhythm of living, where mornings begin gazing out to the horizon, days unfold barefoot, and life follows the tides more than the clock.
about.defaultText2: With just three cosy rooms, all locally crafted using wood and bamboo, with direct jetty access to deep water, and the reef at your doorstep, it's a unique, secluded, nature escape.
about.defaultText3: Swim, snorkel, kayak, fish, explore nearby beaches, or practice yoga on our open decks overlooking the horizon.
about.defaultText4: At night, watch phosphorescent plankton glow beneath you or spot shooting stars above, not forgetting our fresh, abundant meals too. Immerse yourself in this unique tropical island space; slow down, reconnect, contribute sustainably, and connect to nature, all at Floating Paradise.
about.defaultText5: Comfort, exploration, and rejuvenation await in this tropical island paradise. We can't wait to welcome you!

bungalows.defaultText1: Suspended above the reef, our three handcrafted bamboo bungalows invite you to live between sea and sky.
bungalows.defaultText2: Built by hand and shaped by the elements, each bungalow has its own personality; no two are the same. Wake with the sunrise shimmering across the water, watch the tide shift beneath your feet, and fall asleep to the quiet rhythm of the waves.
bungalows.defaultText3: Inside, natural textures and open design create a space that feels both grounded and free. Each bungalow features a queen bed (or larger), a private ensuite with fresh water shower, sink, and flushing toilet, and a generous balcony with comfortable seating; your front-row seat to panoramic views of the sea and mangroves.
bungalows.defaultText4: These are not just rooms, they're a place to exhale, to soften, and to float.

explore.title: Built by Hand,<br class="hidden md:block"/> Powered by Sun
explore.p1: At first glance, Floating may appear simple. Natural materials. Open air. Timber, thatch, weave, salt air. Nothing polished to perfection. Not entirely sealed away from the elements.
explore.p2: And that is exactly the point. Every structure at Floating Paradise is built from natural materials that live in relationship with the sea, the sun, the wind and the rain, they fade and weather. They require care. They need replacing. The roof is renewed. The wood is tended. The details are revisited again and again.
explore.quote: We do not build to resist nature. We build to exist within it.
explore.p3: Choosing natural materials means choosing maintenance over permanence. It means accepting cycles rather than chasing "forever." What may look simple is, in truth, ongoing care, for this bay, for Karimunjawa, for our planet.
explore.p4: Just as intentionally, Floating runs entirely on solar power. There is no mainland grid supporting us. Every light, every fan, every system relies on a carefully built, hand-crafted solar network.
explore.p5: Tono, self-taught and deeply committed, designed and built this system himself. It is safe, reliable and entirely powered by the sun, but it requires constant attention, monitoring, learning and upgrading. Living off-grid is not a shortcut. It is daily devotion.
explore.p6: When you stay here, you are not paying for luxury in the conventional sense. You are supporting craftsmanship. Renewable energy. Natural materials. Cyclical rebuilding. Human hands. Long-term care.
explore.p7: Floating is simple by design. Yet simplicity, when created with intention and responsibility, carries depth and value. It is cared for, again and again.

aboutPage.astridTonoP1: My name is Tono and I am the proud owner of Floating Paradise. I was born and raised in Karimunjawa, and my family have been living and working here for generations. I'm very grateful that I can call this beautiful island home. I'm passionate about sharing this place with others, and making sure we can collectively preserve the island's natural beauty too.
aboutPage.astridTonoP2: Astrid has been traveling her entire life, always seeking new experiences and connections. Yet it was during this particular journey, after nine months of exploring South-East Asia, that she met Tono in Karimunjawa. Sharing similar dreams and values, they quickly formed a deep connection.
aboutPage.astridTonoP3: Together, Astrid and Tono established Floating Paradise, a retreat that embodies their shared vision of peace and harmony with nature.
aboutPage.astridTonoP4: Over the years, they've built a life rooted in their love for the island, setting up an educational charity, constructing their own home and food forest, marrying, and welcoming two children into their lives.
aboutPage.kejoraP1: In 2021, we legally founded a charity called Kejora Karimunjawa, which improves access to quality education on the island.
aboutPage.kejoraP2: Kejora has been successfully running the island's first legal bilingual, nature-based preschool for 3–6-year olds since July 2023, with many children attending on a scholarship.
aboutPage.kejoraP3: We also provide English lessons for primary school children aged 7–12 and for adults working in tourism. We've recently built a library and a second classroom to expand our facilities, paving the way for the introduction of primary education.
aboutPage.kejoraSupportDesc: As we are entirely non-profit, we depend on donors. We are legalised in the Netherlands, meaning you can donate directly to our EU bank account:

gettingHere.title: Getting Here
gettingHere.subtitle: Your journey to paradise begins across the Java Sea.
gettingHere.step1Desc: Jepara is the main port town for boats to Karimunjawa. We recommend spending a night in Jepara before your morning crossing.
gettingHere.step1ByAirDesc: Fly into Semarang (SRG), the closest major airport.
gettingHere.step1ByLandDesc: From Semarang airport or city, you can take a private taxi (approx 2 hours) or a shared shuttle (DayTrans) to Jepara.
gettingHere.step1TrainDesc: The closest train station is Semarang Tawang. From there, take a taxi or shuttle to Jepara.
gettingHere.step2Desc: All passenger boats depart from Pelabuhan Kartini (Kartini Harbour) in Jepara.
gettingHere.step2ExpressDesc2: Express Bahari operates daily between Jepara and Karimunjawa. Schedules vary by month and season — some days offer two departures. We recommend booking your tickets through us for the most up-to-date availability.
gettingHere.step2SiginjaiDesc2: A slower roll-on/roll-off ferry that departs every other day. Tickets can only be bought at the harbour on the day of departure.
gettingHere.step3Desc: Once you arrive at Karimunjawa Harbour, you're almost there! Floating Paradise is located in Legon Lele, a quiet bay on the eastern side of the island.
gettingHere.step3TaxiDesc: Taxi from harbour to Floating Paradise: Rp 150,000 (paid directly to driver, cash)
gettingHere.step3AccessDesc: There is direct road access and parking on site. Follow the path past Bobi Beach — once the brick road ends, turn right onto the dirt track. Continue along the beach, cross the small wooden bridge, and drive directly into our property.

yogaRetreatPage.heroDesc: Step out of your everyday life and find harmony above the sea
yogaRetreatPage.overviewText1: Floating Paradise lives in relationship with its surroundings, shaped by the tides, the wind & the moon's phases. This retreat invites you to tune into your own living flow too.
yogaRetreatPage.overviewText2: The Art of Floating is an intimate, sea-based yoga retreat designed for those ready to embrace a slower, more sustainable rhythm. Set at our solar-powered guesthouse suspended above the water, this retreat blends daily practice, nature immersion, and meaningful contribution, all shaped by the elements of island life.
yogaRetreatPage.overviewText3: Here, yoga is a tool for living, not a performance.
yogaRetreatPage.themesTitle: Across the week, we focus on three core themes:
yogaRetreatPage.theme1Desc: Using yoga to care for yourself physically, mentally, and spiritually, learning to listen, adapt, and build an honest, kind relationship with yourself.
yogaRetreatPage.theme2Desc: Refine alignment, receive hands-on guidance, and explore deeper expressions of classic postures in a supportive, non-competitive space.
yogaRetreatPage.theme3Desc: Practicing presence on and off the mat, discover what it means to "float" in your breath, your body, and your everyday life.
yogaRetreatPage.perfectFor: Perfect for beginners and those ready to deepen their practice. Singles and couples welcome.
yogaRetreatPage.natureDesc1: Floating Paradise is not separate from its environment, and neither is this retreat. Contribution here is quiet, grounded, and meaningful, a reminder that balance includes giving back.
yogaRetreatPage.natureDesc2: In addition, €100 will be donated on your behalf to a local educational charity (included in the retreat price).
yogaRetreatPage.weaveIntro: Throughout the week, we weave inner work with outward care through:
yogaRetreatPage.weave2: Beach clean-ups with a local educational nature-based foundation
yogaRetreatPage.weave3: A full-day boat trip exploring the archipelago and its reefs
yogaRetreatPage.weave5: Snorkelling, swimming, and unstructured hours in wild nature
yogaRetreatPage.dailySubtitle: An unhurried flow designed to harmonize with the sun and sea.
yogaRetreatPage.scheduleDawnDesc: Morning yoga, blending meditation and pranayama.
yogaRetreatPage.scheduleMorningDesc: Fresh breakfast followed by nature-based activities (kayaking, snorkeling, swimming) or free time.
yogaRetreatPage.scheduleMiddayDesc: Locally prepared lunch & rest during the warmest hours.
yogaRetreatPage.scheduleEveningDesc: Plant-based buffet dinner followed by either a sharing circle, Yoga Nidra or Yin Yoga session.
yogaRetreatPage.dailyFooter: Throughout the week: Yogic dharma inspired by the Yamas & Niyamas woven gently into the retreat.
yogaRetreatPage.foodQuote: "This is food that nourishes, delights, and feels aligned with the spirit of the retreat."
yogaRetreatPage.foodDesc: Floating Paradise is typically known for its specialty local seafood dishes: vibrant, generous plates always served with seasonal vegetables, fresh fruit, and plenty of love. For this retreat, we're elevating our menu into a nourishing fusion experience: classic Indonesian flavours reimagined with wholesome plant-based proteins, colourful salads, and touches of cross-Asian inspiration woven throughout.
yogaRetreatPage.yes1: You're fairly new to yoga or want to refine foundations
yogaRetreatPage.yes2: You want to spend time in nature that feels meaningful and restorative
yogaRetreatPage.yes3: You want to learn more about mindfulness and intentional living (yogic dharma)
yogaRetreatPage.yes4: Reconnect with your body and inner compass
yogaRetreatPage.yes5: You want to slow down without guilt
yogaRetreatPage.yes6: You want to develop tools to live yoga off the mat
yogaRetreatPage.no4: You are looking for advanced, athletic yoga training
yogaRetreatPage.meetAstridP1: Astrid is the heart of the yoga experience at Floating Paradise, guiding with a gentle presence, and grounded in wisdom. She completed her 200-hour Yoga Teacher Training in India in 2020 and has been teaching here ever since, focusing on classic hatha and hatha flow practices, blending pranayama & meditation into classes that are accessible, balanced, and deeply nourishing.
yogaRetreatPage.meetAstridP2: Guests at Floating frequently highlight her relaxed, supportive teaching style and the special magic of practicing yoga on the jetty at sunset, with the sound of water and the horizon stretching beside them.
yogaRetreatPage.testi1: "The yoga sessions with Astrid on the wooden jetty were a highlight, just like meditating there after dinner, with nothing but the moon and the stars above you, the jungle around you and the water beneath you. My retreat at floating paradise truly left a mark and will stay with me."
yogaRetreatPage.testi2: "For me her style was the perfect mixture between healthy exercise and wholesome meditation. In her class I felt completely safe and comfortable. She has a great deal of knowledge and experience, while staying humble. I definitely recommend practicing yoga with Astrid."
yogaRetreatPage.investmentSubtitle: Transparent details for your peace of mind.
yogaRetreatPage.investmentFooter: All prices are per person and include the full 7-day retreat experience.
yogaRetreatPage.included2: All yoga, meditation, and evening practices
yogaRetreatPage.notIncluded2: Travel to Karimunjawa (although we can arrange this for you)
yogaRetreatPage.notIncluded3: Alcohol and food ordered offsite (at the beach/cafes etc.)

yogaRetreatPage.cancelInsurance: We strongly recommend purchasing travel insurance that covers trip cancellation, medical expenses, and travel delays.

yogaRetreatPage.cancelByUs1: A full refund of all payments made,
yogaRetreatPage.cancelByUs2: The option to transfer your payment to a future retreat
yogaRetreatPage.cancelByUsFooter: Floating Paradise is not responsible for flights, ferry tickets, or additional travel expenses.
